extraction_notes: Family datasheet covering BZX584C2V4 through BZX584C43; the BZX584C18 row (marking code Y6) was used for all part-specific table values.
Zener impedance for variant-Z fitting (no dedicated schema field): ZZT = 45 ohm maximum at IZT = 0.005 A; ZZK = 225 ohm maximum at IZK = 0.001 A (p. 2 Electrical Characteristics, BZX584C18 row).
Typical temperature coefficient at IZTC: +12.4 to +16.0 mV/degC; admissible zener current IZM listed as 5 mA in the table (p. 2).
Maximum ratings (p. 1): PD = 150 mW, VF = 0.9 V max at IF = 10 mA, RthJA = 833 degC/W, Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 degC.

Fig.2 (p. 3) labels each trace with its nominal voltage; the 18 V trace is well separated from the neighboring 16 V and 20 V traces, so attribution is unambiguous. Digitized VZ spans 17.86-18.20 V, inside the table window 16.8-19.1 V, and the local slope between 1 mA and 4.1 mA is approximately 42 ohm, consistent with the 45 ohm ZZT maximum.
The drawn 18 V trace terminates against the power-derating envelope at approximately 4.2 mA, slightly below IZT = 5 mA, so the digitized curve tops out there; extrapolation to 5 mA was not performed.
Axis calibration was verified against eight independent log-decade gridlines (match within 1 px at 400 dpi) and the 2.5 V minor grid on the linear voltage axis.

Capacitance is a single digitized read of the 0 V bias family typical-capacitance curve at nominal VZ = 18 V (approximately 16.6 pF; the 1 V bias curve reads approximately 12.6 pF and the 50%-of-VZ bias curve approximately 6.8 pF); it is not a swept characteristic of this part.
Forward voltage is a single maximum limit (0.9 V at 10 mA) from the ratings table; the datasheet provides no forward I-V curve, so only one VF point is available.
omission_reason: Remaining figures omitted: Fig.1 covers only the 2.4-10 V family members, Fig.3 (temperature coefficient), Fig.4 (leakage), Fig.5 (capacitance) and Fig.6 (impedance) plot family-level quantities versus nominal zener voltage rather than operating characteristics of this part, so only single-point reads (capacitance) were taken from them. The Fig.2 trace above approximately 4.2 mA is not drawn (it ends at the power-derating envelope), so no points near or above IZT = 5 mA could be digitized.
